purpose: First governed Knowledge Object registry. A Knowledge Object AGGREGATES governed claims/evidence into one coherent reference object; it does NOT re-own atomic facts. Knowledge-Object-Before-URL is absolute: a KO is an internal governed object and authorizes no route/HTML/sitemap/indexation.
one_fact_one_owner: Evidence owns source literals/measurements/locators/uncertainty/scope. Claims own governed propositions/boundaries. A Knowledge Object owns ONLY: which claims belong together, which evidence supports them, conceptual organization, scope boundaries, unresolved/excluded areas, and reference role. No numeric value is copied into a KO as a second editable truth; display values are DERIVED from evidence.

record_schema.note: derived_contract_c is a DERIVED projection of postures via contract_c_derive.derive(); it is documentation only and must equal the recomputed value (validated by tests). It is never a manual authorization.

knowledge_objects.scope: The scientifically established chemical identity and BULK structural facts BISULFID can currently support for molybdenum disulfide: the formula MoS2; that bulk MoS2 is layered; the 2H polytype hexagonal P6_3/mmc (No. 194) structure; and the 2H-bulk in-plane lattice parameter a. ONE coherent scientific reference object. It is NOT a complete MoS2 article, a band-gap page, a safety/market/industrial-use page, a German-terminology page, or a monolayer guide.
knowledge_objects.boundary_note: EVD-MOS2-3R-BOUNDARY-RSC documents the DISTINCT 3R polytype (R3m) as boundary/context. It is NOT part of the 2H claim and is bound here only as a polytype boundary, never as 2H structural support.
unresolved_fields: band gap (form-dependent: bulk 2H indirect vs monolayer direct) — not acquired; future work
other physical/material properties (density, optical, lubricant) — not in scope this object
3R-polytype lattice parameters as primary facts (held only as boundary/context)

german_lexical_object.reason: The German lexical chain is a TERMINOLOGY knowledge role (a German dictionary-entry observation), a different subject domain (SD-TERMINOLOGY/SD-LINGUISTICS), a different evidence set (Spektrum), and a different reference task. It is NOT merged into this scientific object.

posture_notes.evidence_posture: DERIVED via the admission engine over the bound evidence (A/B/C each evidence_sufficient; aggregate = evidence_sufficient). Source locks remain candidate, so NO evidence_locked.
posture_notes.claim_posture: claim_pending — the bound claims are pilot_non_operational and are NOT promoted into an active canonical claim registry by this sprint.
posture_notes.information_gain_posture: ig_not_reviewed — a completed human-readable IG review exists (see publication candidate + report), but current governance ratifies no non-numeric IG pass authority, so the posture stays ig_not_reviewed pending ratification.

derived_contract_c.derived_by: scripts/governance_scaffolding/contract_c_derive.py derive(reference_draft, evidence_sufficient, claim_pending, not_validated, ig_not_reviewed, not_authorized)

knowledge_objects.notes: First production Knowledge Object (Reference Production 01). Aggregates Pilot-03 governed scientific claims/evidence without re-owning facts. Authorizes NO route/HTML/sitemap/indexation; Knowledge-Object-Before-URL is absolute.
